4462.title: Provider event delivery and inter-item timing
4462.rootCauseOneLine: Production latency is not isolated: shared runtime progress does not wait for event-post acknowledgement; stored event timestamps are batch-ingestion timestamps.
4462.proposedFix: Obtain matched real-provider traces and the audit query before changing event persistence; no verified failing regression supports a simple fix.
4462.caveats: Both clean runs use the trusted scripted bridge and real in-memory SQLite, not the affected endpoints, live provider adapters, fleet dataset, or disk-loaded server. No-repro is limited to these probes.
